latestRelease.title: Version 9.6.19: Stocking a Shelf from the Shelf

items.description: The + Stock button on an empty shelf slot opens the item editor right there. It used to send you to Settings → Merchant and leave you to find the New Item button yourself.
That editor is now one shared dialog, so a new item started from the shelf and one started from settings are the same form with the same fields and the same price check.
